shadow.note: By day the orange is sunlit: a top highlight, a hairline underneath. The glow (rim plus halo on every side, never a drop shadow) comes on when someone hovers, focuses or presses. At night it glows at rest and brighter on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-action
tokens.usage: Primary button at rest by day: sunlight on its top edge and a hairline underneath.

tokens.name: shadow-action-strong
tokens.usage: Burnt buttons and treat chips by day.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The lit layer: lit rim plus halo, on every side. By day it appears on hover and focus. At night it is on at rest, turned down and held close to the button.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-hover
tokens.usage: The lit layer under the pointer or in focus. At night the light turns up, held to about the reach of the ThemeToggle lamp; by day it matches `shadow-glow`.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-chip
tokens.usage: Treat chips: a sunlit edge by day, softly glowing glass at night.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-marker
tokens.usage: Treat markers at rest: a thin dark edge by day, a glow at night.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-marker-hover
tokens.usage: A treat marker under the pointer, focused or selected: the light comes on.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-meter
tokens.usage: Treated meter fill: a crisp edge by day, a glow at night.

tokens.name: shadow-sheen-shell
tokens.usage: Shell buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-sheen-agave
tokens.usage: Agave buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Paper cards. The only drop shadow in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-raise-on-band
tokens.usage: Cards sitting on a shell or agave band.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Sunken tracks: the meter.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the ground color, then a solid 2px `focus` ring (7:1 by day, 10:1 at night).

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Grain over every gradient: buttons, sheens, the lit layer.

tokens.name: grain-opacity-ground
tokens.usage: Grain over a whole band.

tokens.name: photo-brightness-dark
tokens.usage: Photos dim to this brightness at night, so glowing markers stay the brightest thing.

lighting.note: Distances in px for the lighting engine. Reach is how far a light carries before it fades out; height is how far it stands off the wall.

tokens.name: lamp-reach
tokens.usage: How far the lamp lights a wall.

tokens.name: lamp-height
tokens.usage: How far the lamp stands off the wall. Lower makes longer, more raking light.

tokens.name: tube-reach
tokens.usage: How far a tube lights the wall around it.

tokens.name: tube-height
tokens.usage: How far a tube stands off the wall.

tokens.name: status-reach
tokens.usage: How far a status light reaches. Keep it small.

tokens.name: status-height
tokens.usage: How far a status light stands off the wall.

tokens.name: corrugation
tokens.usage: Spacing of the ridges on corrugated tin.

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and press changes that are not the glow.

tokens.name: duration-glow
tokens.usage: How long the glow takes to come up on hover or focus. It fades out over 1.5 times this.

tokens.name: duration-ping
tokens.usage: One pulse of a treat marker’s ring.

tokens.name: duration-flicker
tokens.usage: The flicker-on, played once when the main button first comes into view (never on a click or hover): the light stutters on over the first ~19% (about half a second), holds, and by day settles back to sunlit by the end.

tokens.name: duration-breathe
tokens.usage: One breath of the main action’s glow (night only).

tokens.name: duration-glint
tokens.usage: One cycle of the sun glint across a button (day). It moves for the last quarter and rests the rest.
